summaries.en: T5-base is a versatile text-to-text transformer model that converts all NLP tasks into text generation problems, enabling unified training and inference. Its key innovation treats every task as 'text in, text out' - whether summarization, translation, or question answering - using the same model architecture and training objective. You can fine-tune it on custom datasets using Hugging Face Transformers, experiment with prompt engineering for zero-shot learning, or deploy it for multilingual applications by leveraging its cross-lingual capabilities.
summaries.zh: T5-base是一种创新的文本到文本转换模型，将各类自然语言处理任务统一为文本生成形式，通过相同输入输出格式处理摘要、翻译、问答等任务。其核心设计采用统一转换框架消除传统架构差异，使单个模型能借助不同前缀指令执行多任务。开发者可通过Hugging Face库微调自定义数据，运用提示工程实现零样本学习，或利用多语言能力构建跨语言应用，为通用语言系统开发提供新范式。
